usedFor: Grist holds your records, and Eden AI checks their text when “New Record” runs “AI Generated Content Detection”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Record” in Grist, then “AI Generated Content Detection” in Eden AI
bestTemplate.why: Each new row gets its text checked for AI authorship, so you spot machine-written entries without reading them all.

watchOut: “Updated Record” also fires, so an edited record in Grist can be checked again by Eden AI.
